zh: 拖动琴弓模拟长音、滑音与轻柔弦乐。
en: Drag the bow to shape long notes, glides, and soft strings.

zh: 轻触敲击或自动节奏，用于专注与放松。
en: Tap manually or use auto rhythm for focus and relaxation.

zh: 慢速双细分，适合呼吸、阅读和长时间稳定跟拍。
更快节奏和短段循环，适合收尾冲刺或整理动作。
en: Faster tempo with short sections for closing sprints or cleanup routines.

zh: 一拍一声，低干扰，适合快速进入专注。
en: One click per beat with low distraction for quick focus.

zh: 一键切换速度、拍号、细分、音色和视觉，先开始再细调。
适合空气感更强、细节更明亮的输入。
en: Best for airy input with brighter detail.

zh: 适合贴近琴体、桌面或外壳的低噪声拾音。
en: For low-noise pickup close to an instrument body, desk, or shell.

zh: 适合较强声压和嘈杂环境。
en: Good for higher sound pressure and noisy spaces.

zh: 适合电吉他等磁性拾音输入。
en: For magnetic pickup inputs such as electric guitar.

zh: 适合原声乐器桥位或贴片拾音。
en: For bridge or surface pickup on acoustic instruments.

zh: 请先选择可编辑的格子
试试更短的关键词，或切换搜索模式。
en: Try a shorter query or switch the search mode.

zh: 可以直接新增单词，或先导入内容再回来编辑。
en: Add a word directly, or import content and come back to edit it here.

zh: 进入全屏后使用现代五孔布局和触控气流面板演奏。
en: Enter fullscreen to play with modern five-hole fingering and a touch air panel.

zh: 现代尺八通常是五孔端吹竹管，前四后一；一尺八寸管常以 D 为筒音。
en: Modern shakuhachi is usually an end-blown bamboo flute with five holes, four front and one rear; the 1.8 length is commonly rooted in D.

zh: 现代常见尺八为竹制端吹管，吹口有斜切歌口，五个指孔为前四后一。长度以一尺八寸最常见，筒音约 D；更长的管音更低，更短的管音更高。
en: A common modern shakuhachi is a bamboo end-blown flute with an angled blowing edge and five finger holes: four front, one rear. The 1.8 length is the standard D instrument; longer flutes sound lower and shorter flutes sound higher.

zh: 尺八音色带有明显气声、竹管共鸣和边棱噪声，弱吹可近似耳语，强吹会更明亮粗粝。真实演奏会用气口角度、口腔形状、meri/kari 俯仰和半孔改变音高与音色。
en: Its tone includes breath noise, bamboo resonance, and edge turbulence. Soft blowing can feel whisper-like; strong blowing becomes brighter and rougher. Real players shape pitch and color with embouchure, mouth cavity, meri/kari angle, and half-holing.

zh: 基础音列可理解为全按 D，逐步开放得到 F、G、A、C、D。实际尺八不是简单键盘：手指半开、气息强弱、吹口角度和头部俯仰都会让同一指法产生不同音高和色彩。
en: The basic scale can be read as all holes closed for D, then opening holes for F, G, A, C, and D. A real shakuhachi is not a simple keyboard: half holes, breath, embouchure, and head angle make one fingering produce different pitches and colors.

zh: SiliconFlow 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/speech 接口；模型与音色需由当前账号支持。
en: SiliconFlow uses an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint; models and voices must be supported by your account.

zh: 阿里百炼默认使用 DashScope 语音模型；Qwen TTS Instruct 会用语速指令贴近当前朗读速度。
en: Ali Bailian uses DashScope speech models by default; Qwen TTS Instruct receives a speed instruction matching the current reading speed.

zh: 豆包语音合成需要 App ID 与访问令牌；模型字段对应火山语音 cluster。
en: Doubao TTS requires an App ID and access token; the model field maps to the Volcano speech cluster.

zh: 自定义 TTS 需提供 OpenAI 兼容 Base URL、模型 ID、音色 ID 和 API Key。
en: Custom TTS needs an OpenAI-compatible base URL, model ID, voice ID, and API key.

zh: SiliconFlow 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/transcriptions 接口，适合跟读识别与语音输入。
en: SiliconFlow uses an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint for follow-along recognition and voice input.

zh: 阿里百炼识别会把录音作为音频输入发送到 DashScope 多模态接口。
en: Ali Bailian recognition sends the recording as audio input to the DashScope multimodal endpoint.

zh: 豆包识别会把录音作为音频输入发送到火山方舟 Responses 接口。
en: Doubao recognition sends the recording as audio input to the Volcano Ark Responses endpoint.

zh: 自定义 ASR 需提供 OpenAI 兼容 Base URL、模型 ID 和 API Key。
en: Custom ASR needs an OpenAI-compatible base URL, model ID, and API key.

zh: 统一配置本地朗读、远程 TTS、模型、音色和语言。
en: Configure local reading, remote TTS, models, voices, and languages in one place.

zh: 调整后立即试听当前发音效果。
en: Preview pronunciation immediately after changing settings.

zh: 当前没有可试听的单词
调整朗读语速和音量，播放页会同步使用。
en: Adjust reading speed and volume; the playback page uses the same values.

zh: 复用已下载的远程音频，减少重复请求。
en: Reuse downloaded remote audio to reduce repeated API calls.

zh: 启用本地 API 语音缓存
远程 TTS 需要 API Key；模型拉取失败时仍可手动输入模型 ID。
en: Remote TTS requires an API key; if model fetching fails, you can still enter a model ID manually.

zh: 豆包 TTS 需要 App ID 与访问令牌；模型字段对应火山语音 cluster。
en: Doubao TTS needs an App ID and access token; the model field maps to the Volcano speech cluster.

zh: 自定义 TTS 需要 API Key 与 Base URL；模型和音色需由服务端支持。
en: Custom TTS needs an API key and base URL; models and voices must be supported by the server.

zh: 先选 provider，再选可用于 TTS 的模型、语言和该模型支持的音色。
en: Choose the provider first, then a TTS-capable model, language, and a supported voice for that model.

zh: 使用系统或本机 TTS 音色。
en: Use a system or device TTS voice.

zh: 模型刷新只保留 TTS 候选；不同平台的音色不会混用。
en: Model refresh keeps only TTS candidates; voices are not shared across providers.

zh: 例如：温柔、低声、适合睡前复习。阿里按提示词传入；豆包按 emotion 字段透传。
en: Example: gentle, quiet, suitable for bedtime review. Aliyun receives it as an instruction; Doubao receives it through the emotion field.

zh: 远程请求会按队列执行，遇到限流或临时失败时按重试次数重试。
en: Remote requests run through a queue and retry on rate limits or temporary failures.

zh: 俄罗斯方块、消消乐、推箱子、数独、扫雷、拼图、五子棋和 2048 合并成一个轻量游戏中心。
en: Tetris, match-3, Sokoban, Sudoku, Minesweeper, jigsaw, Gomoku, and 2048 share one compact game hub.

zh: 滑动交换相邻图块，连成 3 个或更多即可消除；在倒计时内冲目标分，连锁会奖励时间。
en: Swipe adjacent tiles, clear runs of 3 or more, and reach the target score before the timer runs out. Cascades add time.

zh: 滑动交换、连锁加时并冲目标分
en: Swipe, chain time bonuses, and chase the target score

zh: 滑动图块交换，也可以点选两个相邻图块。
en: Swipe a tile to swap, or tap two adjacent tiles.

zh: 已选中图块，点相邻图块或滑动图块尝试交换。
en: Tile selected. Tap an adjacent tile or swipe a tile to try a swap.

zh: 这次交换没有形成三连，已撤回。
en: That swap made no match, so it was reverted.

zh: 消除 {count} 个，连锁 {chain}x，+{seconds} 秒
没有可用交换，棋盘已重排。
en: No valid swap remained, so the board was reshuffled.
No moves left before reaching the target.
Time is up before reaching the target.

zh: 移动端优先的 VeraCrypt 容器解密、浏览、导出与创建工具。
en: Mobile-first VeraCrypt container tool for decrypting browsing exporting and creating containers.

zh: 解锁 .hc/.tc 或无扩展名容器，在 App 内只读浏览导出，也可创建新容器。
en: Unlock .hc/.tc or extensionless containers for read-only in-app browsing and export or create a new container.

zh: 选择容器后按需解锁头部、解密数据区并打开 App 内文件浏览，不把大型容器整体载入内存。
en: After choosing a container, unlock the header, decrypt the data area, and open in-app file browsing as needed without loading large containers fully into memory.

zh: 选择本机可访问的 VeraCrypt 文件容器。移动端需要平台返回可 seek 的文件路径。
en: Choose a locally accessible VeraCrypt file container. Mobile platforms must provide a seekable file path.

zh: 输入口令、PIM 和 keyfile 后可解锁容器头、探测数据区，并在 App 内打开只读文件浏览导出文件。
en: Enter passphrase, PIM, and keyfile to unlock the container header, probe the data area, and open read-only in-app file browsing for export.

zh: 按 VeraCrypt 文件卷布局展示主头、隐藏卷头、标准备份头和隐藏备份头窗口。
en: Shows primary, hidden, standard backup, and hidden backup header windows according to the VeraCrypt file-volume layout.

zh: 当前固定移动端能力边界：App 内解锁、只读浏览导出和创建新容器，系统挂载不在范围内。
en: Current mobile boundaries are explicit: in-app unlock, read-only browsing/export, and new-container creation; system mounting is out of scope.

zh: 移动端不会把 VeraCrypt 挂载成系统盘；浏览和导出只在 App 内只读执行，创建容器会另存新文件。
en: Mobile does not mount VeraCrypt as a system drive; browsing and export run read-only in-app and container creation saves a new file.

zh: 当前平台没有返回可 seek 的文件路径。为避免读取完整大容器，本阶段不会继续检查。
en: This platform did not return a seekable file path. To avoid reading a full large container, inspection stops here.

zh: AES-XTS 已用于主头和数据区解密；非 AES 与级联算法仍待兼容测试。
en: AES-XTS is used for header and data-area decryption; non-AES and cascaded algorithms still need compatibility testing.

zh: Twofish、Serpent、Camellia、Kuznyechik 及级联组合需要逐项兼容测试后再启用。
en: Twofish, Serpent, Camellia, Kuznyechik, and cascades require compatibility tests before enabling.

zh: PBKDF2 哈希组合会在只读卷头解锁阶段接入。
en: PBKDF2 hash combinations will be wired during the read-only header unlock phase.

zh: PIM、Argon2id 与 keyfile 组合需要移动端性能和内存上限评估。
en: PIM, Argon2id, and keyfile combinations require mobile performance and memory-limit evaluation.

zh: 首个文件系统目标是 FAT32 只读浏览和单文件导出。
en: The first filesystem target is FAT32 read-only browsing and single-file export.

zh: Android/iOS 无 root 场景不承诺系统级挂载；桌面挂载也不在当前应用边界内。
en: System-level mount is not promised on Android/iOS without root; desktop mounting is also outside this app boundary.

zh: 尚未读取容器。请选择本机可访问的文件容器。
en: No container has been read. Choose a locally accessible file container.

zh: 该文件小于 VeraCrypt 文件卷头部和备份头区域所需的最小布局。
en: This file is smaller than the minimum layout needed for VeraCrypt file-volume headers and backup headers.

zh: 主卷头窗口位于文件开头 512 字节。
en: The primary volume header window is the first 512 bytes of the file.

zh: 隐藏卷头候选窗口位于 64 KiB 偏移处；本阶段只识别窗口，不判断是否存在隐藏卷。
en: The hidden-volume header candidate window starts at the 64 KiB offset; this phase identifies the window but does not determine whether a hidden volume exists.

zh: 备份头位于文件末尾 128 KiB 区域内，不是简单的最后 512 字节。
en: Backup headers sit inside the final 128 KiB area, not simply the last 512 bytes.

zh: 当前阶段是检查器：不会写入容器，不会修改源文件。
en: This phase is an inspector: it does not write the container or modify the source file.

zh: 移动端路线是 App 内只读浏览/导出，不提供系统盘符或全局文件系统挂载。
en: The mobile path is app-internal read-only browsing/export, not a drive letter or global filesystem mount.

zh: 偏移 {offset}，可读 {bytes} 字节，salt 指纹 {fingerprint}
当前平台没有返回可 seek 的 keyfile 路径，因此未读取 keyfile。
en: This platform did not return a seekable keyfile path, so the keyfile was not read.

zh: 已读取 {bytes} 字节用于指纹，未触及上限 {limit} 字节。
en: Hashed {bytes} bytes for the fingerprint, below the {limit}-byte limit.

zh: 已按上限读取 {bytes}/{limit} 字节用于指纹，未全量载入 keyfile。
en: Hashed the capped {bytes}/{limit} bytes for the fingerprint; the keyfile was not fully loaded.

zh: 只检查口令是否填写、PIM 格式和 keyfile 指纹；不会尝试解密卷头。
en: Checks passphrase presence, PIM format, and keyfile fingerprint only; it does not try to decrypt the header.

zh: 下一步：补入口令或 keyfile，然后解锁容器头或打开文件浏览。
en: Next: add a passphrase or keyfile then unlock the container header or open file browsing.

zh: 下一步：选择满足 VeraCrypt 文件卷最小布局的大容器。
en: Next: choose a larger container that meets the VeraCrypt file-volume layout floor.

zh: 下一步：该容器和材料已完成阶段 1 预检，可进入后续只读卷头解锁开发。
en: Next: this container and material passed phase-1 preflight and are ready for later read-only header unlock work.

zh: 下一步：选择 .hc、.tc 或无扩展名容器。
en: Next: choose a .hc, .tc, or extensionless container.

zh: 下一步：复核文件扩展名；仍可检查布局，但不会把它标记为可解锁候选。
en: Next: review the file extension. Layout can still be inspected, but it is not marked as an unlock candidate.

zh: .hc 是 VeraCrypt 文件容器的常见扩展名。
en: .hc is a common VeraCrypt file-container extension.

zh: 该扩展名不是 .hc、.tc 或无扩展名；本阶段只做结构复核。
en: This extension is not .hc, .tc, or extensionless; this phase only reviews the structure.

zh: .tc 常见于 TrueCrypt 旧版容器；兼容解锁需要后续单独验证。
en: .tc is common for legacy TrueCrypt containers; compatible unlock needs separate later validation.

zh: 无扩展名容器符合 VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt 常见用法；仍需口令材料才能后续解锁。
en: Extensionless containers match common VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt usage; later unlock still needs credential material.

zh: Keyfile 长度为 0，后续解锁材料不应依赖它。
en: The keyfile length is 0; later unlock material should not rely on it.

zh: 未选择 keyfile；如果容器创建时使用了 keyfile，后续解锁会缺少材料。
en: No keyfile selected. If the container was created with one, later unlock will lack material.

zh: Keyfile 指纹已读取；页面不会显示或保存其原始内容。
en: The keyfile fingerprint was read; the page does not display or store its raw content.

zh: 材料预检只服务后续只读解锁开发，不代表当前已经解密或验证卷头。
en: Material preflight only supports later read-only unlock work; it does not mean the header is decrypted or verified now.

zh: 尚未填写口令；大多数容器后续解锁至少需要口令或 keyfile。
en: No passphrase entered. Most containers need at least a passphrase or keyfile for later unlock.

zh: 口令已填写；页面只记录长度，不展示、不记录口令内容。
en: Passphrase entered. The page records only its length and does not display or store the content.

zh: PIM 留空时按默认 PIM 路线进入后续兼容评估。
en: Blank PIM follows the default-PIM path for later compatibility evaluation.

zh: PIM 必须为空或正整数；请先修正后再进入后续解锁尝试。
en: PIM must be blank or a positive integer. Correct it before a later unlock attempt.

zh: PIM 格式有效；实际迭代次数和性能成本会在后续解锁阶段评估。
en: PIM format is valid. Actual iterations and performance cost will be evaluated in the later unlock phase.

zh: Salt 指纹来自每个 512 字节头部窗口前 64 字节，只用于区分窗口，不证明口令正确或隐藏卷存在。
en: Salt fingerprints come from the first 64 bytes of each 512-byte header window. They only distinguish windows and do not prove a correct passphrase or hidden volume.

zh: 其他 KDF / 级联算法
PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256 已用于 AES-XTS 主头解锁、数据区读取和创建新容器；其他 KDF 仍待接入。
en: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256 is used for AES-XTS header unlock, data-area reads, and new-container creation; other KDFs are not wired yet.

zh: Whirlpool、BLAKE2s、Streebog、Argon2id、Serpent/Twofish/Camellia 与级联算法仍在后续兼容矩阵中。
en: Whirlpool, BLAKE2s, Streebog, Argon2id, Serpent/Twofish/Camellia, and cascades remain in the later compatibility matrix.

zh: 解锁信息可用于容器解密；后续浏览和导出只在 App 内执行，不做系统挂载。
en: Unlock information is ready for container decryption; later browsing and export stay in-app and do not use system mounting.

zh: 下一步：点击“只读解锁主头”，验证当前已支持的 VeraCrypt 卷头组合。
en: Next: tap "Read-only unlock header" to verify a currently supported VeraCrypt header combination.

zh: 仅解密 512 字节主头并校验 CRC；不保存口令，不挂载，不读取卷内文件。
en: Only the 512-byte primary header is decrypted and CRC-checked; the passphrase is not saved, the volume is not mounted, and files inside are not read.

zh: 显示通过 magic 与 CRC 验证后的只读卷头元数据。
en: Shows read-only header metadata only after magic and CRC validation.

zh: 头部声明存在隐藏卷大小
en: Header declares a hidden volume size

zh: 当前主头未声明隐藏卷大小；隐藏卷头未在本结果中排除。
en: The current primary header does not declare a hidden-volume size; hidden headers are not ruled out by this result.

zh: 主头窗口不足 512 字节，无法执行解密验证。
en: The primary header window is smaller than 512 bytes, so decryption cannot be verified.

zh: PIM 必须为空或不超过 VeraCrypt 上限的正十进制整数。
en: PIM must be empty or a positive decimal integer within the VeraCrypt limit.

zh: 请先输入口令或选择 keyfile，再尝试解锁主头。
en: Enter a passphrase or choose a keyfile before trying to unlock the primary header.

zh: 当前仅支持 VeraCrypt 128 字节以内的 UTF-8 口令材料。
en: Only VeraCrypt UTF-8 passphrase material up to 128 bytes is supported in this pass.

zh: 已通过 VERA magic、头字段 CRC 与 master key 区 CRC 校验。
en: VERA magic, header-field CRC, and master-key-area CRC all verified.

zh: 本结果只证明主头可解密；文件浏览和导出需继续打开只读文件浏览，不会系统挂载或写入原容器。
en: This only proves the primary header can be decrypted; file browsing and export require opening the read-only file browser and do not system-mount or write the original container.

zh: 主头解密失败，已回退到容器末尾的标准备份头并通过校验；建议尽快修复或重建主头。
en: The primary header failed to decrypt; verification passed after falling back to the standard backup header at the container tail. Consider repairing or rebuilding the primary header soon.

zh: 当前候选 cipher/KDF 组合均未通过 magic 与 CRC 校验。
en: Current candidate cipher/KDF combinations did not pass magic and CRC validation.

zh: 可能原因包括口令/PIM/keyfile 不匹配，或容器使用了 Serpent/Kuznyechik、BLAKE2s/Streebog、隐藏头等尚未接入路径。
en: Possible causes include mismatched passphrase/PIM/keyfile, or a container using Serpent/Kuznyechik, BLAKE2s/Streebog, hidden headers, or another path that is not wired yet.

zh: 主头验证成功后，可只读解密数据区开头摘要，或在下方打开文件浏览导出文件；不挂载、不写入原容器。
en: After the header verifies, decrypt a bounded data-area summary read-only, or open file browsing below to export files; the original container is not mounted or written.

zh: 显示从已验证主头提取的 AES-XTS 数据区 key 所解密的有限首段摘要。
en: Shows a bounded leading-sample summary decrypted with the AES-XTS data-area key extracted from the verified primary header.

zh: 从 {start} 开始，共 {count} 个单元
疑似 FAT 启动扇区
已使用主头中的 AES-XTS 数据区 key 解密容器数据区开头的有限字节。
en: A bounded leading sample of the container data area was decrypted with the AES-XTS data-area key from the primary header.

zh: 本结果只证明数据区首段可被解密读取；目录浏览和导出使用下方只读文件浏览，不会系统挂载或写入原容器。
en: This only proves the leading data-area sample can be decrypted and read; directory browsing and export use the read-only file browser below and do not system-mount or write the original container.

zh: 首个解密扇区包含 FAT 标签和启动签名，可尝试在 App 内浏览目录。
en: The first decrypted sector contains a FAT label and boot signature; in-app directory browsing can be attempted.

zh: 首段解密成功，但当前启发式未确认 FAT；exFAT、NTFS 和其他布局仍在后续兼容范围内。
en: The leading sample decrypted successfully, but the current heuristic did not confirm FAT; exFAT, NTFS, and other layouts remain future compatibility work.

zh: 已解锁主头，但加密区起点、长度或扇区大小不满足本轮有限只读探测条件。
en: The primary header unlocked but the encrypted-area start length or sector size does not meet this pass's bounded read-only probe requirements.

zh: 下一步：点击“只读探测数据区”，验证卷内容加密区首段能被当前头部的 XTS 数据区密钥解密。
en: Next: tap "Read-only probe data area" to verify that the leading encrypted content area can be decrypted with the XTS data-area key from the current header.

zh: 数据区首段已完成只读解密探测；下一步可打开文件浏览并导出选中文件。
en: The leading data-area sample has been decrypted read-only; next, open file browsing and export selected files.

zh: 只读会话已就绪，可浏览 FAT 卷并导出选中文件。
en: Read-only session ready; you can browse the FAT volume and export selected files.

zh: 缺少可用主头，无法打开只读会话。
en: No usable primary header; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 需要口令或 keyfile 才能打开只读会话。
en: A passphrase or key file is required to open a read-only session.

zh: PIM 无效，无法打开只读会话。
en: PIM is invalid; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 解锁材料不受支持，无法打开只读会话。
en: Unlock material is not supported; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 主头解锁失败，无法打开只读会话。
en: Primary header unlock failed; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 解锁成功后，可在 App 内浏览 FAT 目录并导出单个文件；不会挂载系统盘，不会写入容器。
en: After unlocking, browse the FAT directory in-app and export a single file; no system drive is mounted and the container is never written.

zh: 此操作只解密卷内容用于只读浏览；不会创建、修改或删除容器内任何文件。
en: This only decrypts volume content for read-only browsing; it never creates, modifies, or deletes any file inside the container.

zh: 正在解锁并读取文件系统…
选择一个文件以查看预览并导出。
en: Select a file to preview and export it.

zh: 解密后的数据区首扇区缺少 FAT 引导扇区或启动签名。
en: The first decrypted data-area sector is missing the FAT boot sector or boot signature.

zh: BPB 字节每扇区不是受支持的 FAT 值。
en: The BPB bytes-per-sector is not a supported FAT value.

zh: BPB 字段不合理：扇区/簇、保留扇区、FAT 数量、根目录或簇区范围不满足 FAT 约束。
en: BPB fields are implausible: sectors/cluster, reserved sectors, FAT count, root directory, or cluster region do not satisfy FAT constraints.

zh: 簇链过长，已超过只读浏览的安全上限，解析中止。
en: The cluster chain is too long and exceeds the read-only safety limit; parsing stopped.

zh: 检测到簇链环路，可能容器损坏，解析中止。
en: A cluster-chain cycle was detected, suggesting a damaged container; parsing stopped.

zh: 簇链中遇到坏簇标记（0x0FFFFFF7），可能存储介质损坏，解析中止。
en: A bad-cluster marker (0x0FFFFFF7) was encountered in the cluster chain, suggesting damaged storage; parsing stopped.

zh: 簇号越界，超出了卷簇数范围。
en: A cluster number is out of range, beyond the volume cluster count.

zh: 目录条目数过多，已超过只读浏览的安全上限。
en: The directory entry count exceeds the read-only safety limit.

zh: 读取加密数据区失败，可能容器被截断或损坏。
en: Failed to read the encrypted data area; the container may be truncated or damaged.

zh: 目录列表为只读；不会创建、修改或删除条目。
en: Directory listing is read-only; entries are never created, modified, or deleted.

zh: 文件内容为只读读取；不会写入容器。
en: File content is read-only; the container is never written.

zh: 文件超过导出上限，已截断导出。
en: The file exceeds the export limit; the export was truncated.

zh: FAT12/16/32 只读浏览与单文件导出已部分支持（当前已支持的主头 cipher/KDF 组合）；exFAT、NTFS 和隐藏卷仍待评估。
en: FAT12/16/32 read-only browsing and single-file export are partially supported for currently supported primary-header cipher/KDF combinations; exFAT, NTFS, and hidden volumes remain to be evaluated.

zh: FAT12/16/32 已有文件等长写回已部分支持（当前已支持的主头 cipher/KDF 组合，可写文件句柄）；不创建、删除、重命名、扩容或分配簇。
en: Same-size overwrites of existing FAT12/16/32 files are partially supported for currently supported primary-header cipher/KDF combinations with a writable file handle; files are not created, deleted, renamed, expanded, or assigned new clusters.

zh: 已支持服务层创建 AES、Twofish、Camellia 或 AES-Twofish XTS 的 FAT 根目录容器并写入根目录文件；文件名会写成兼容 8.3 短名，目录树、隐藏卷和 Serpent/Kuznyechik 仍待扩展。
en: The service can create FAT root-directory containers with AES, Twofish, Camellia, or AES-Twofish XTS and write root files; file names are stored as compatible 8.3 short names, while directory trees, hidden volumes, and Serpent/Kuznyechik remain future work.

zh: 选择一个或多个普通文件，使用当前口令/PIM/keyfile 生成 VeraCrypt 容器；不会挂载系统盘。
en: Choose one or more regular files and create a VeraCrypt container using the current passphrase/PIM/keyfile; no system drive is mounted.

zh: 尚未选择要写入容器的文件。
en: No source files selected for the container.

zh: 已选择 {count} 个源文件，合计 {size}。
请先输入用于新容器的口令。
en: Enter a passphrase for the new container first.

zh: 部分源文件没有可读取路径，已跳过；请改选本地文件。
en: Some source files have no readable path and were skipped; choose local files instead.

zh: 下一步：点击“打开文件浏览”，在 App 内浏览 FAT 目录。
en: Next: tap "Open file browser" to browse the FAT directory in-app.

zh: 已打开只读文件浏览；可选择目录或文件进行浏览，选中文件可导出。
en: Read-only file browsing is open; you can browse directories or files, and export a selected file.

zh: AES、Twofish、Camellia 与 AES-Twofish XTS 已接入主头解锁、数据区读写和创建容器；含 Serpent/Kuznyechik 的组合仍需后续核心。
en: AES, Twofish, Camellia, and AES-Twofish XTS are wired for header unlock, data-area reads/writes, and container creation; combinations that include Serpent or Kuznyechik still need cipher cores.

zh: 当前 Dart 依赖不提供 Serpent 或 Kuznyechik；启用前需要 VeraCrypt 原生核心或已验证的纯 Dart 算法适配。
en: Current Dart dependencies do not provide Serpent or Kuznyechik; enabling them requires the VeraCrypt native core or a verified pure Dart adapter.

zh: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool 与 Argon2id 已接入主头 key 派生；Argon2id 自动候选试探限制在 128 MiB 内，移动端 UI 暂不主动暴露选择入口。
en: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool and Argon2id are wired for header-key derivation; automatic Argon2id candidate attempts are limited to 128 MiB, so the mobile UI does not expose an active selector yet.

zh: 当前 Dart 依赖缺少 VeraCrypt 所需的 BLAKE2s-256 与 Streebog 派生核心；相关容器不会标成已支持。
en: Current Dart dependencies lack the BLAKE2s-256 and Streebog derivation cores VeraCrypt needs; those containers are not marked as supported.

zh: AES、Serpent、Twofish、Camellia、Kuznyechik 及 VeraCrypt 官方 XTS 级联已接入主头解锁、数据区读写和创建容器。
en: AES, Serpent, Twofish, Camellia, Kuznyechik, and VeraCrypt's official XTS cascades are wired for header unlock, data-area reads/writes, and container creation.

zh: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool/BLAKE2s/Streebog 与 Argon2id 已接入主头 key 派生；Argon2id 自动候选试探限制在 128 MiB 内，移动端 UI 暂不主动暴露选择入口。
en: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool/BLAKE2s/Streebog and Argon2id are wired for header-key derivation; automatic Argon2id candidate attempts remain limited to 128 MiB, so the mobile UI does not expose an active selector yet.

zh: 点击收起配置。当前摘要会保留在上方，解密时不会显示这些加密侧提示。
en: Tap to collapse settings. The summary stays above; decrypt mode does not show these encryption-side hints.

zh: 点击展开加密配置，可调整算法、派生密钥长度、完整性校验和限制策略。
en: Tap to expand encryption settings for algorithms, derived key size, integrity checks, and limit rules.

zh: 每一轮独立派生密钥，级联顺序写入受认证信封，解密无需手选算法。
en: Each round derives an independent key; cascade metadata is authenticated so decrypt does not require manual algorithm selection.

zh: 可使用口令、一个密钥文件或多个无序组合密钥文件共同派生主密钥。
en: Use a passphrase, one key file, or multiple order-insensitive key files to derive the master key.

zh: 已达到本次会话的最大解密次数，页面内敏感状态已清除。
en: The session decrypt limit was reached; in-page sensitive state has been cleared.

zh: 正在解密并校验 .vsc 信封文件...
加密完成，.vsc 信封文件大小 {size}。
错误次数达到上限，页面内敏感状态已清除。
en: The error limit was reached; in-page sensitive state has been cleared.

zh: 请先选择要处理的文件。
高性能本地文件加密，输出带认证元数据的 .vsc 信封文件，支持多密钥文件与算法级联。
en: High-performance local file encryption that outputs .vsc envelope files with authenticated metadata, multiple key files, and cipher cascades.

zh: 已生成 {size} 随机密钥文件，指纹 {hash}。
en: Generated a {size} random key file. Fingerprint: {hash}.

zh: 已组合 {count} 个密钥文件，指纹 {hash}。
加密时配置当前页面会话限制；触发后会清除内存中的明文、密钥材料和输出缓存。
en: Configure limits for the current page session while encrypting; when triggered, plaintext, key material, and output cache are cleared from memory.

zh: 注意：若设置最大错误/解密次数并开启随机覆写，触发限制后源文件可能被尽力覆写并删除；不需要该行为时请保持次数为 0 或关闭覆写。
en: Warning: if max errors/decrypts and random overwrite are enabled, hitting a limit may overwrite and delete the source file on a best-effort basis. Keep limits at 0 or disable overwrite if you do not want that.

zh: 0 表示不限；1-99 次失败后清除页面状态。
en: 0 means unlimited; 1-99 failed attempts clear page state.

zh: 加密生成 .vsc 自描述信封文件；解密从信封文件自动读取算法、级联与校验信息。
en: Encryption creates a self-describing .vsc envelope file; decryption reads algorithm, cascade, and verification metadata from that envelope file.

zh: 处理完成后会在这里显示输出文件指纹。
en: The output file fingerprint appears here after processing.

zh: 仅当本地路径可用时尝试随机覆写并删除；浏览器或受限平台只清除页面缓存。
en: Attempts random overwrite and delete only when a local path is available; browsers or restricted platforms clear only page cache.

zh: 触发限制时尽力随机覆写源文件
en: Best-effort random overwrite source on limit

zh: 可留空，但建议与密钥文件组合使用
en: Can be empty, but pairing with key files is recommended

zh: 导出前可核对文件名、大小和 SHA-256 指纹。
en: Review file name, size, and SHA-256 fingerprint before export.

zh: 选择 .vsc 加密信封文件；算法、级联、MAC 和签名信息会自动识别。
en: Choose a .vsc encrypted envelope file; algorithm, cascade, MAC, and signature metadata are detected automatically.

zh: 选择本地明文文件，输出为带认证元数据的 .vsc 加密信封文件。
en: Choose a local plaintext file; output is a .vsc encrypted envelope file with authenticated metadata.

zh: 面向本地高性能的多算法文件加密工具，输出可导出的 .vsc 加密信封文件。
en: A local high-performance multi-algorithm file encryption tool that outputs exportable .vsc encrypted envelope files.

zh: 已触发限制，页面状态已清除，并已尽力随机覆写删除源文件。
en: Limit triggered; page state was cleared and the source file was overwritten and deleted on a best-effort basis.

zh: 多个密钥文件会按名称、长度和指纹规范化排序，导入顺序不会影响结果。
en: Multiple key files are normalized by name, length, and fingerprint, so import order does not change the result.

zh: 使用口令、盐和 KDF 强度派生可复现密钥文件，适合与随机密钥文件组合。
en: Derive a reproducible key file from passphrase, salt, and KDF strength; useful together with random key files.

zh: 生成随机密钥文件失败：{error}
正在生成随机密钥文件...
生成、派生和组合独立密钥文件，用于文件加密模块的多因子密钥材料。
en: Generate, derive, and combine standalone key files for multi-factor key material in file encryption.

zh: 32 字节到模块上限，常用 4096 字节。
en: 32 bytes up to the module limit; 4096 bytes is typical.

zh: 选择随机生成、口令派生或把多个现有密钥文件组合为一个新材料。
en: Choose random generation, passphrase derivation, or combine existing key files into new material.

zh: 生成或组合后会在这里显示密钥文件指纹。
en: The key file fingerprint appears here after generation or combine.

zh: 用于可复现派生，请单独安全保存
en: Used for reproducible derivation; store it separately and securely

zh: 使用安全随机源生成不可复现的二进制密钥文件。
en: Generate a non-reproducible binary key file with a secure random source.

zh: 随机密钥文件已生成，大小 {size}，指纹 {hash}。
en: Random key file generated. Size: {size}. Fingerprint: {hash}.

zh: 导出前核对文件名、大小和 SHA-256 指纹；密钥内容不会显示。
en: Review file name, size, and SHA-256 fingerprint before export; key content is not displayed.

zh: 同一口令和盐会派生同一密钥文件。
en: The same passphrase and salt derive the same key file.

zh: 选择生成方式后创建或组合密钥文件。
en: Choose a generation mode to create or combine a key file.

zh: 独立生成、口令派生和无序组合密钥文件，供文件加密模块叠加使用。
en: Generate, passphrase-derive, and order-insensitively combine standalone key files for the file encryption module.

zh: 直接加密或解密文本内容，输出可复制的 Base64 v5 加密信封。
en: Encrypt or decrypt text content directly and copy the Base64 v5 envelope.

zh: 复用文件加密算法族处理文本内容，生成可复制、可粘贴的 Base64 加密信封。
en: Use the file encryption algorithm set for text content and produce copyable Base64 envelopes.

zh: 输入明文可生成加密信封，或粘贴 Base64 信封进行解密。
en: Enter plain text to create an encrypted envelope, or paste a Base64 envelope to decrypt.

zh: 选择生成新信封，或解开已有 Base64 v5 信封。
en: Choose whether to create a new envelope or open an existing Base64 v5 envelope.

zh: 输入需要保护的 UTF-8 文本。
en: Enter the UTF-8 text you want to protect.

zh: 粘贴由本模块生成的 Base64 v5 加密信封。
en: Paste a Base64 v5 encrypted envelope generated by this module.

zh: 算法、KDF 强度、密钥位宽和校验方式与文件加密模块保持一致。
en: Algorithms, KDF strength, key width, and integrity checks match the file encryption module.

zh: 同一口令与密钥文件组合必须在加密和解密时保持一致。
en: Use the same passphrase and key file combination for encryption and decryption.

zh: 已生成 {size} 的 Base64 加密信封。
en: Generated a Base64 encrypted envelope of {size}.

zh: 已解密出 {size} 的明文文本。
加密模式输出 Base64 信封；解密模式输出 UTF-8 明文。
en: Encrypt mode outputs a Base64 envelope; decrypt mode outputs UTF-8 plain text.

zh: 计算文本或文件的 MD5、SHA、SHA3、BLAKE2b 与 Whirlpool 摘要，并与可信来源提供的期望摘要比对。
en: Calculate MD5, SHA, SHA3, BLAKE2b, and Whirlpool digests for text or files and compare them with expected digests from a trusted source.

zh: 对文本或文件生成常见散列摘要，并做公开摘要比对；来源认证请使用签名或 HMAC。
en: Generate common hash digests for text or files and compare public digests; use signatures or HMAC for source authentication.

zh: 输入文本或选择文件后即可计算摘要。
en: Enter text or choose a file to calculate its digest.

zh: 选择直接输入文本，或从本地选择一个文件计算摘要。
en: Choose direct text input or select a local file to calculate a digest.

zh: 选择需要计算的摘要算法；MD5/SHA-1 仅适合兼容校验。
en: Choose the digest algorithm; MD5 and SHA-1 are for compatibility checks only.

zh: 可选：粘贴已知摘要，结果会同时按 Hex 和 Base64 比对。
en: Optional: paste a known digest; the result is compared as Hex and Base64.

zh: 支持 Hex 或 Base64，空格和换行会被忽略。
en: Hex or Base64 is supported; spaces and line breaks are ignored.

zh: 同时显示 Hex 和 Base64 形式，便于复制到外部系统。
en: Shows both Hex and Base64 forms for external systems.

zh: 生成本地 RSA/ECC 密钥，完成签名验签，并用 RSA-OAEP 处理小文本加解密。
en: Generate local RSA/ECC keys, sign and verify messages, and use RSA-OAEP for small-text encryption.

zh: 管理 RSA-2048 与 ECC P-256 密钥，支持签名验签和 RSA 小文本加解密。
en: Manage RSA-2048 and ECC P-256 keys with signing, verification, and RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 先生成或粘贴密钥，再进行签名、验签或 RSA 小文本加解密。
en: Generate or paste keys before signing, verifying, or using RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 按任务切换密钥生成、签名验签或 RSA 小文本加密。
en: Switch between key generation, signing and verification, or RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 密钥只在本地生成并以模块专用 JSON 文本展示。
en: Keys are generated locally and shown as module-specific JSON text.

zh: 私钥用于生成签名，公钥与签名文本用于验证消息是否匹配。
en: Use the private key to sign, then verify the message with the public key and signature text.
Signature does not match the message.

zh: 使用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 处理短文本；长内容请使用文本加密信封。
en: Use RSA-OAEP-SHA256 for short text; use text encryption envelopes for longer content.

zh: 公钥可直接复制；私钥默认隐藏，只在确认保存时显示。
en: Public keys can be copied directly. Private keys are hidden by default and shown only when you confirm storage.

zh: 私钥已默认隐藏。只有在准备离线保存到安全位置时再显示；显示或复制后请避免截屏、剪贴板同步和共享屏幕。
en: Private key is hidden by default. Reveal it only when you are ready to store it in a secure offline location; avoid screenshots, clipboard sync, and screen sharing after revealing or copying.

zh: 复制私钥会把明文私钥写入系统剪贴板；请尽快粘贴到安全存储，并在平台允许时清理剪贴板历史。
en: Copying the private key writes the plain key to the system clipboard. Paste it into secure storage promptly and clear clipboard history when the platform allows it.

zh: 密钥对已生成，公钥指纹 {fingerprint}。
en: Key pair generated. Public key fingerprint: {fingerprint}.

zh: 正在进行 RSA 加密...
RSA 密文已生成：{size} 字节。
正在进行 RSA 解密...
文本加密复用文件加密的 v5 信封；RSA 仅适合小文本，长内容请优先使用对称加密信封。
en: Text encryption reuses the file encryption v5 envelope; RSA is only for small text, so use symmetric envelopes for longer content.

zh: 先封装为 v5 加密信封，再无损排列成 PNG 色块或 PCM WAV 采样。
en: Encrypt into a v5 envelope, then arrange it losslessly as PNG color blocks or PCM WAV samples.

zh: 将文本或文件加密后生成可还原的 PNG 色块图或 WAV 频谱音频。
en: Encrypt text or files into restorable PNG color-block images or WAV spectrum audio.

zh: 当前明文内容为 {size}，会先写入加密信封。
en: Current plain content is {size}; it will be wrapped in an encrypted envelope first.

zh: 选择本模块生成的 PNG 或 WAV，再用同一口令和密钥文件还原。
en: Choose a PNG or WAV generated by this module, then restore it with the passphrase and key files.

zh: 创建会生成新的媒体文件；还原只读取本模块生成的 PNG/WAV。
en: Encode creates a new media file; restore only reads PNG/WAV files generated by this module.

zh: 输入文本或选择本地文件；输出媒体会大于加密信封本身。
en: Enter text or choose a local file; the output media will be larger than the encrypted envelope.

zh: 加载网络图片/本地媒体
输入 HTTPS PNG 地址，或选择本模块生成的本地 PNG/WAV。
en: Enter an HTTPS PNG URL or choose a local PNG/WAV generated by this module.

zh: PNG 更容易查看色块；WAV 用采样值频谱承载同一加密信封。
en: PNG is easier to inspect as color blocks; WAV carries the same encrypted envelope as sample-value spectrum data.

zh: PNG 以 RGB 色块无损保存加密载荷；重新压成 JPEG 会破坏还原。
en: PNG stores the encrypted payload losslessly in RGB blocks; recompressing as JPEG will break restoration.

zh: WAV 以单声道 PCM16 采样保存加密载荷；转为 MP3/AAC 会破坏还原。
en: WAV stores the encrypted payload as mono PCM16 samples; transcoding to MP3/AAC will break restoration.

zh: 安全性来自 v5 加密信封；媒体排列只是可校验的无损承载层。
en: Security comes from the v5 encrypted envelope; media arrangement is only a verifiable lossless carrier.

zh: 还原需要同一口令和同一组密钥文件。
en: Restoration requires the same passphrase and the same key-file set.

zh: 请先输入文本或选择文件。
en: Enter text or choose a file first.

zh: 请先选择本模块生成的 PNG 或 WAV。
en: Choose a PNG or WAV generated by this module first.

zh: 导出后请保留原始 PNG/WAV 格式，不要重新压缩或转码。
en: After export, keep the original PNG/WAV format and do not recompress or transcode it.

zh: 加密载荷过大，无法编码为图片。
en: Encrypted payload is too large for image media.

zh: 图片媒体无效或不受支持。
en: Image media is invalid or unsupported.

zh: 图片尺寸过大，无法安全解析。
en: Image media dimensions are too large.

zh: 加密信封过大，无法编码为媒体。
en: Encrypted envelope is too large for media encoding.

zh: 加密媒体载荷版本不受支持。
加密媒体载荷长度无效。
en: Encrypted media payload length is invalid.

zh: 加密媒体载荷校验失败。
音频不是受支持的 WAV 文件。
en: Audio media is not a supported WAV file.
Audio media must be PCM WAV.

zh: 音频必须是单声道 PCM16 WAV。
en: Audio media must be mono PCM16 WAV.
Encrypted media payload header is invalid.

zh: 这是从加密媒体中解出的原始文本，可直接复制；文件导出仍保留在结果区。
en: This is the original text restored from encrypted media. You can copy it now; file export remains available in the result panel.

zh: 密钥文件长度必须在 32 字节到 1 MB 之间。
en: Key file length must be between 32 bytes and 1 MB.

zh: 限制只作用于当前页面会话；触发后会随机覆写页面内缓存的明文、媒体、输出和密钥材料。
en: Limits apply only to this page session. When triggered the page random-overwrites cached plaintext media output and key material.

zh: 触发后覆写并删除选中媒体
en: Overwrite and delete selected media when triggered

zh: 仅在平台提供真实可写路径时尝试；Web、只读副本或系统托管文件会降级为页面内存清理。
en: Only attempted when the platform provides a real writable path. Web read-only copies and system-managed files fall back to in-page cleanup.

zh: 已达到最大可解密次数，页面内缓存已随机覆写并清除。
en: Maximum decrypt count reached. Cached page data was random-overwritten and cleared.

zh: 已达到最大错误次数，页面内缓存已随机覆写并清除。
en: Maximum error count reached. Cached page data was random-overwritten and cleared.

zh: 已触发限制，并已尽力随机覆写删除选中的本地媒体文件。
en: Limit triggered and selected local media was best-effort random-overwritten and deleted.

zh: 请先生成 PNG 结果。
正在生成传输损坏模拟副本...
已生成损坏模拟副本；视觉高位被扰动，低位载荷仍可还原。
en: Damaged simulation copy created. Visual high bits were disturbed while payload low bits remain restorable.

zh: 损坏模拟需要本页新版自然化 PNG。
en: Damage simulation requires a naturalized PNG generated by this page.

zh: 请先生成 PNG 加密图片。
en: Generate an encrypted PNG image first.

zh: 正在上传加密 PNG 到 Uguu 临时空间...
en: Uploading encrypted PNG to Uguu temporary storage...

zh: 可将当前加密 PNG 上传到 Uguu 公共临时空间。链接是公开地址，服务策略和可达性可能变化。
en: You can upload the current encrypted PNG to Uguu public temporary storage. The link is public and service policy or reachability may change.
Could not open the temporary link.

zh: 网络 PNG 图片地址
正在加载网络加密 PNG...
试听当前加密 WAV 承载音频。
en: Preview the current encrypted WAV carrier audio.

zh: 正在试听加密 WAV 承载音频。
仅支持 HTTPS 图片地址。
en: Only HTTPS image URLs are supported.

zh: 网络图片地址不能指向本机或私有网络。
en: Network image URL cannot point to localhost or a private network.

zh: 网络图片重定向次数过多。
en: Network image has too many redirects.

zh: 网络响应不是 PNG 图片。
en: Network response is not a PNG image.

zh: 网络图片超过大小限制。
en: Network image exceeds the size limit.

zh: 使用共享密钥为文本或文件生成消息认证码，并可粘贴摘要做常量时间格式校验。
en: Generate a message authentication code for text or files with a shared secret, then paste a digest for constant-time format-aware verification.

zh: 为文本或文件生成 HMAC，并校验对方提供的 Hex/Base64 认证码。
en: Generate HMAC for text or files and verify Hex/Base64 authentication codes from another party.

zh: 输入消息和共享密钥后生成 HMAC；普通散列不具备认证语义。
en: Enter a message and shared secret to generate HMAC; plain hashes do not provide authentication.

zh: 当前输入大小 {size}，可生成或校验认证码。
en: Current input size is {size}; ready to generate or verify the authentication code.

zh: 可直接输入短文本，也可选择本地文件计算 HMAC。
en: Enter short text directly or choose a local file for HMAC.

zh: HMAC 需要双方持有同一密钥；不要把密钥和消息一起发送。
en: HMAC requires both sides to hold the same secret; do not send the secret with the message.

zh: 密钥只保存在当前页面状态中，清除或离开页面后不持久化。
en: The secret stays only in current page state and is not persisted after clearing or leaving the page.

zh: SHA-256 适合默认认证；SHA-1 仅用于兼容旧系统。
en: SHA-256 is the default authentication choice; SHA-1 is only for legacy compatibility.

zh: 可粘贴对方提供的 Hex 或 Base64 HMAC，生成后自动比对。
en: Paste a Hex or Base64 HMAC from another party; it is compared after generation.

zh: 支持 Hex 或 Base64；留空则只生成。
en: Supports Hex or Base64; leave empty to only generate.

zh: 复制前核对算法、输入大小和摘要格式。
en: Review algorithm, input size, and digest format before copying.

zh: 生成后会在这里显示 Hex 和 Base64 HMAC。
en: Hex and Base64 HMAC appear here after generation.

zh: 离线批量生成随机密码，也可生成口令短语并估算熵强度；结果不写入本地存储。
en: Generate random password batches offline or create passphrases with entropy estimates; results are not written to local storage.

zh: 离线批量生成高强度密码和口令短语，适合配合加密信封或 key file 使用。
en: Generate strong password batches and passphrases offline for encrypted envelopes or key files.

zh: 设置字符集后生成一次性结果；页面不会保存历史记录。
en: Configure character sets and generate one-time results; this page keeps no history.

zh: 已生成 {count} 条结果，首条估算熵约 {entropy} bits。
en: Generated {count} results; first estimate is about {entropy} bits of entropy.

zh: 密码适合系统字段；口令短语适合手动输入和记忆。
en: Passwords fit system fields; passphrases are easier to type and remember manually.

zh: 至少保留一种字符集；可追加自定义字符集，默认排除容易混淆的字符。
en: Keep at least one character set; you can add a custom set and ambiguous characters are excluded by default.

zh: 可追加项目要求的专用字符；留空则只使用勾选字符集。
en: Add project-specific characters; leave empty to use only selected sets.

zh: 默认填入 0Ool1I| 等易混淆字符；可按场景增删。
en: Defaults to ambiguous characters such as 0Ool1I|; edit for the target system.

zh: 从内置离线词表随机抽词；词表本身不代表助记词标准。
en: Randomly draws from the built-in offline word list; this is not a mnemonic seed standard.

zh: 复制后请放入密码管理器或加密存储，离开页面前按需清除。
en: Move copied values into a password manager or encrypted storage and clear this page when done.

zh: 点击生成后会在这里显示批量结果。
en: Generated batches appear here after you tap Generate.

zh: 本地计算一次性验证码，支持 Base32 密钥、TOTP 时间步和 HOTP 计数器。
en: Calculate one-time codes locally with Base32 secrets, TOTP time steps, and HOTP counters.

zh: 本地生成或校验 TOTP/HOTP 一次性验证码，不保存账户令牌。
en: Generate or check TOTP/HOTP one-time codes locally without storing account tokens.

zh: 输入 Base32 密钥后计算当前时间步或指定计数器。
en: Enter a Base32 secret to calculate the current time step or a chosen counter.

zh: 已计算计数器 {counter} 的验证码。
可粘贴认证器密钥，也可生成新的随机密钥用于迁移演练。
en: Paste an authenticator secret or generate a new random secret for migration practice.

zh: 支持空格、短横线和 Base32 padding；不会写入本地存储。
en: Spaces, hyphens, and Base32 padding are accepted; nothing is written to local storage.

zh: 已生成随机 Base32 密钥。
TOTP 使用当前时间步；HOTP 使用手动计数器。
en: TOTP uses the current time step; HOTP uses a manual counter.
Common value is 30; allowed range is 10-300.

zh: HOTP 每次使用后通常递增。
en: HOTP usually increments after each use.

zh: 大多数认证器默认使用 SHA-1；只有服务端明确支持时才改用 SHA-256/SHA-512。
en: Most authenticators use SHA-1 by default; use SHA-256/SHA-512 only when the service explicitly supports them.

zh: 结果是当前输入的本地计算值，不代表账户已绑定或可登录。
en: The result is calculated locally from current input and does not mean the account is enrolled or login-ready.

zh: 计算后会在这里显示验证码。
en: The code appears here after calculation.

zh: 把文本秘密或加盐密码定义拆分为阈值分片，或用足够分片恢复；分片请分开保存。
en: Split a text secret or salted password definition into threshold shares or recover it from enough shares; store shares separately.

zh: 把密钥、助记文本、恢复口令或加盐密码定义拆成阈值分片，并在本地恢复。
en: Split keys, mnemonic text, recovery passphrases, or salted password definitions into threshold shares and recover them locally.

zh: 输入文本秘密或定义加盐密码并设置阈值，或粘贴足够分片恢复。
en: Enter a text secret or define a salted password with a threshold, or paste enough shares to recover.

zh: 已生成 {shares} 个分片，任意 {threshold} 个可恢复。
分片用于分散保管；恢复需要达到阈值数量且分片未损坏。
en: Split for distributed custody; recovery requires enough intact shares.

zh: 本轮 UI 处理文本秘密和加盐密码定义；二进制密钥可后续接入密钥文件管理。
en: This UI handles text secrets and salted password definitions; binary keys can be wired through key-file management later.

zh: 不要在不可信屏幕或日志中展示真实密钥。
en: Do not display real secrets on untrusted screens or logs.

zh: 仅用于本地派生 vspwd1 定义，不写入分片文本。
en: Used only to derive the local vspwd1 definition and not written into share text.

zh: 默认随机生成，可按需要替换。
生成分片前会把密码和盐派生为 vspwd1 定义；恢复结果不是原始密码。
en: Before splitting the password and salt derive a vspwd1 definition. Recovery returns that definition not the original password.
Must be at least the threshold and at most 16.

zh: 每行粘贴一个 vss1 分片；重复、损坏或阈值不足会被拒绝。
en: Paste one vss1 share per line; duplicate, damaged, or insufficient shares are rejected.

zh: 至少粘贴达到阈值数量的分片。
en: Paste at least the threshold number of shares.

zh: 请分别保存分片；不要把所有分片放在同一位置。
en: Store shares separately; do not keep every share in the same place.

zh: 执行分片或恢复后会在这里显示结果。
en: Results appear here after splitting or recovery.

zh: 本地加密保存账号记录；选择保险库后输入对应凭据解锁。
en: Store account records in a local encrypted vault; select a vault and unlock it with the matching credentials.

zh: 加密网站/渠道、账号、密码、提示和备注；只允许导入导出加密 vault 文件。
en: Encrypt website/channel, account, password, hint, and notes; import and export encrypted vault files only.

zh: 输入主密码和二次规则后解锁；本地文件不保存明文网站、账号或密码。
en: Enter the master password and secondary rule to unlock; the local file stores no plaintext sites, accounts, or passwords.

zh: 选择保险库并输入密码即可解锁；更多说明已收进右侧指南。
en: Select a vault and enter its password to unlock; details are collected in the guide on the right.

zh: 已解锁 {count} 条记录；密码按需单条解密。
en: Unlocked {count} records; passwords decrypt one record at a time.

zh: 先选择保险库并输入对应凭据；匹配后会打开可用内容。
en: Select a vault and enter matching credentials; matching credentials open the available contents.

zh: 同一个保险库入口可按不同凭据进入对应内容；请确保不同凭据不要相同或混用。
en: The same vault entry can open the matching contents for different credentials; keep those credentials distinct and do not mix them.

zh: 如果创建时绑定了独立密钥文件，解锁、导入和主密码变更时都需要同一密钥文件。
en: If an independent key file was bound at creation, the same key file is required for unlock, import, and master password changes.

zh: 迁移只导出加密原始文件；可再通过文件加密、隐写或临时空间传递，不提供明文导出。
en: Migration exports only the encrypted raw file; you can pass it through file encryption, steganography, or temporary storage, and plaintext export is not provided.

zh: 主密码和二次规则会组成真实解密密码；规则值只保留在本次会话中。
en: The master password and secondary rule define the real decrypt password; rule values stay in this session only.

zh: 可以直接输入最终密码；选择二次规则时，本页会先转换后再参与加密。
en: You may enter the final password directly; if a secondary rule is selected, this page transforms it before encryption.

zh: 已解锁并载入 {count} 条记录。
本地还没有记录；添加第一条后会创建加密 vault 文件。
en: No local records yet; adding the first item creates the encrypted vault file.

zh: 已锁定并清空页面明文列表。
en: Locked and cleared the in-page plaintext list.

zh: 可选择前缀/后缀、简单替换或位移规则；迁移到其他设备时必须使用同一规则。
en: Choose prefix/suffix, simple substitution, or shift rules; use the same rule when migrating to another device.

zh: 保持主密码不变；也可以手动计算最终密码后直接输入。
en: Keep the master password unchanged; you can also calculate the final password manually and type it directly.

zh: 会旋转拉丁字母和数字；其他字符保持不变。
en: Rotates Latin letters and digits; other characters stay unchanged.

zh: 解锁后可搜索、复制、编辑或删除；保存时只写入重新加密后的记录。
en: After unlocking, search, copy, edit, or delete; saving writes only re-encrypted records.

zh: 按网站/渠道、账号、提示或备注筛选。
en: Filter by website/channel, account, hint, or notes.

zh: 导入完成，已载入 {count} 条记录。
仅提供增强和极强；每条记录都会独立选择级联算法并衍生密钥。
en: Only Enhanced and Extreme are offered; every record selects its cascade and derives keys independently.

zh: 此保险箱共有 {count} 条记录。
还没有记录。新条目会立即加密写入本地 vault。
en: No records yet. New items are encrypted into the local vault immediately.

zh: 没有匹配当前搜索的记录。
en: No records match the current search.

zh: {stages} 层级联 · {cipherBits}-bit AEAD 密钥 · {materialBits}-bit 派生材料
密码已复制，请注意系统剪贴板风险。
en: Password copied; watch the system clipboard risk.

zh: 删除“{name}”？保存后需要依赖其他备份恢复。
en: Delete "{name}"? After saving, recovery requires another backup.

zh: 记录已删除并保存加密 vault。
en: Record deleted and encrypted vault saved.

zh: 迁移只移动加密 vault 文件；不提供明文导出。
en: Migration moves only the encrypted vault file; plaintext export is not provided.

zh: 只允许导出加密原始文件。设备迁移时，可将该文件再经过内容图片化/音频化、图片隐写、文件加密或其他临时空间工具传递；在新设备下载后，用相同主密码和二次规则导入。
en: Only encrypted raw-file export is allowed. For device migration, you may pass that file through content-to-image/audio, steganography, file encryption, or another temporary-space tool; after downloading on the new device, import it with the same master password and secondary rule.

zh: 替换规则的原字符和替换字符数量必须一致。
en: The substitution rule must map the same number of characters.

zh: 请至少输入网站/渠道或账号。
en: Enter at least a website/channel or an account.

zh: 请输入需要保存的密码。
记录文本过长，请拆分或缩短后再保存。
en: Record text is too long; split or shorten it before saving.

zh: 该记录超过 vault 条目大小限制。
en: This record is too large for the vault.

zh: vault 文件过大或记录数量过多。
en: The vault file is too large or has too many records.

zh: vault 文件结构无效或已损坏。
en: The vault file structure is invalid or damaged.

zh: 不支持该 vault 文件版本。
en: This vault file version is unsupported.

zh: 记录无法解密，请检查密码、规则或文件完整性。
en: The record cannot be decrypted; check the password, rule, or file integrity.

zh: 解锁失败，请检查主密码、二次规则或文件完整性。
en: Unlock failed; check the master password, secondary rule, or file integrity.

zh: 操作失败，请检查输入或文件状态。
en: The operation failed; check the input or file state.

zh: 选择要解锁的本地保险库；每个保险库可使用不同主密码和密钥文件。
en: Select a local vault to unlock; each vault can use a different master password and key file.

zh: 还没有本地保险库。先创建一个新保险库，或导入加密 vault 文件。
en: No local vaults yet. Create a new vault or import an encrypted vault file.

zh: 初次使用时先创建保险库；主密码是解锁核心，可选密钥文件会作为额外独立因子。
en: Create a vault first; the master password is the unlock core, and an optional key file adds an independent factor.

zh: 仅保存不会暴露密码的自定义提示，例如线索词或记忆规则。
en: Save only a hint that does not reveal the password, such as a cue word or memory rule.

zh: 开启后删除本保险库前必须验证密码；关闭后仍会二次确认。
en: When enabled, deleting this vault requires password verification; when disabled, deletion still asks for confirmation.

zh: 输入此保险库的主密码；如果创建时绑定了独立密钥文件，解锁前必须先导入同一密钥文件。
en: Enter this vault master password; if it was bound to an independent key file, import the same key file before unlocking.

zh: 选择保险库后输入对应凭据解锁。
en: Select a vault, then enter matching credentials to unlock it.

zh: 输入对应凭据解锁保险库。
en: Enter matching credentials to unlock the vault.

zh: 未导入密钥文件。没有绑定密钥文件的保险库可仅用主密码解锁。
en: No key file imported. Vaults without a bound key file can be unlocked with the master password only.

zh: 这些规则只作为人脑二次加密教程和提示，不会写入保险库，也不会参与真实 KDF。
en: These rules are only human secondary-encryption guidance; they are not stored in the vault and do not participate in the real KDF.

zh: 直接保存真实密码，或在解锁后按自己的记忆规则手动补算真实密码。
en: Store the real password directly, or manually apply your remembered rule after decrypting.

zh: 建议把规则本身作为单独的管理对象保存或记忆；保险库只负责保护已输入的数据，不会替你恢复忘记的规则。
en: Consider managing or memorizing the rule itself separately; the vault protects entered data but cannot recover a forgotten rule.

zh: 默认不显示完整列表；请搜索账号、备注或网站，或显式点击显示全部。密码字段会单条按需解密。
en: The full list is hidden by default; search by account, note, or website, or explicitly show all. Password fields decrypt one record at a time.

zh: 按网站/渠道、账号、提示或备注匹配；空搜索默认不显示条目。
en: Match by website/channel, account, hint, or notes; an empty search shows no records by default.

zh: 默认隐藏完整条目列表。输入搜索词，或点击显示全部。
en: The full record list is hidden by default. Enter a search term or tap Show all.

zh: 索引已解锁 {count} 条；密码仍保持加密，直到单条获取。
en: {count} indexes are unlocked; passwords remain encrypted until fetched individually.

zh: 设置只作用于当前保险库；默认强度影响新增或重新保存的记录。
en: Settings apply only to the current vault; default strength affects new or re-saved records.

zh: 备用入口同步账号索引，但保存随机占位密码；通过备用入口进入时不能编辑原记录。
en: The alternate entry syncs account indexes but stores random placeholder passwords; content opened through it cannot edit original records.

zh: 启用时必填；请使用与当前密码不同的凭据。
en: Required when enabling; use credentials that differ from the current password.

zh: 备用入口最大解锁次数
填 0 表示不触发清空；达到次数后会清空原记录。
en: Use 0 to disable purging; reaching the limit clears original records.

zh: 修改主密码会重新加密真实保险库记录；当前绑定的密钥文件保持不变。
en: Changing the master password re-encrypts primary records; the currently bound key file is kept.

zh: 主密码已修改，真实记录已重新加密。
en: Master password changed and primary records re-encrypted.

zh: 已以{mode}模式解锁 {count} 条索引；密码按需单条解密。
en: Unlocked {count} indexes in {mode} mode; passwords decrypt one record at a time.

zh: 已以{mode}模式解锁 {count} 条索引。
影子库解锁次数达到上限，真实保险库记录已清空。
en: Shadow unlock limit reached; primary vault records were cleared.

zh: 只允许导出加密原始文件。设备迁移时，可将该文件再经过内容图片化/音频化、图片隐写、文件加密或临时空间工具传递；在新设备下载后，用相同主密码、影子主密码规则和密钥文件导入。
en: Only encrypted raw-file export is allowed. For migration, pass that file through content-to-image/audio, steganography, file encryption, or temporary-space tools; import it on the new device with the same master password, shadow-password setup, and key file.

zh: 两次输入的主密码不一致。
en: The two master password entries do not match.

zh: 密钥文件无效，或与当前保险库绑定的密钥文件不匹配。
en: The key file is invalid or does not match the key file bound to this vault.

zh: 备用入口最大解锁次数无效。
en: The alternate entry unlock limit is invalid.

zh: 请输入有效的保险库名称。
已存在同名保险库，请换一个名称。
en: A vault with this name already exists. Choose another name.

zh: 解锁失败，请检查密码、密钥文件或文件完整性。
en: Unlock failed; check the password, key file, or file integrity.

zh: 只显示可见保险库；隐藏保险库必须输入完整名称后进入。
en: Only visible vaults are listed; enter the full name to access a hidden vault.

zh: 选择本地保险库；输入对应凭据后进入可用内容。
en: Select a local vault; matching credentials open the available contents.

zh: 没有可见保险库。隐藏保险库不会出现在列表中。
en: No visible vaults. Hidden vaults are not shown in the list.

zh: 输入完整名称后才能选择隐藏保险库。
en: Enter the full name to select a hidden vault.

zh: 没有找到该名称的隐藏保险库。
en: No hidden vault with that name was found.

zh: 存在多个同名隐藏保险库，请先在备份中整理名称。
en: Multiple hidden vaults share that name; rename or clean up the backups first.

zh: 已通过名称进入隐藏保险库：{name}
先搜索网站、账号、提示或备注；找到记录后，点击获取密码或复制密码才会解密单条密码。
en: Search website, account, hint, or notes first; after finding a record, tap Get password or Copy password to decrypt only that record.

zh: 空搜索默认不显示条目；输入后可筛选并获取账号信息。
en: An empty search shows no records by default; type to filter and retrieve account information.

zh: 删除“{name}”？这会删除本地加密 vault 文件，恢复只能依赖你另存的备份。
en: Delete "{name}"? This removes the local encrypted vault file; recovery requires a separate backup.

zh: 当前保险库的默认强度、凭据和主密码管理集中在这里。
en: Default strength, credential, and master password management for the current vault are collected here.

zh: 当前保险库不支持修改设置。
en: This vault does not support changing settings.

zh: 默认强度只影响新记录；编辑已有记录会保留原记录强度。
en: Default strength affects only new records; editing an existing record preserves its original strength.

zh: 已启用；保持启用时无需重新输入。
en: Already enabled; no re-entry is needed while keeping it enabled.

zh: 本次新增记录可单独选择强度和本地规则；这些配置不会改变保险库默认设置。
en: This new record can use its own strength and local rule; these choices do not change the vault defaults.

zh: 本次新增记录可单独选择强度；不会改变保险库默认设置。
en: This new record can use its own strength; it does not change the vault default.

zh: 剪贴板与设备安全提示
手机剪贴板、输入法、系统同步和设备环境不可控；可在实际使用的密码基础上额外使用不保存的人脑规则，例如前缀、中缀、后缀、简单替换、记忆码表或自定义规则。例：密码为 prefix123，记录中只保存 123，prefix 由你统一记忆。这样不能替代设备安全，只是聊胜于无。
en: Mobile clipboards, keyboards, system sync, and device environments are outside this vault's control. You can optionally add a non-saved human-memory rule on top of the password you use, such as a prefix, infix, suffix, simple substitution, memory code table, or custom rule. Example: if the password is prefix123, save only 123 and remember prefix yourself. This does not replace device security, but it is better than nothing.

zh: 规则只会在保存前转换本条密码，规则本身不会写入保险库；请确认最终密码符合预期。
en: The rule transforms only this password before saving; the rule itself is not stored in the vault. Confirm the final password is intended.

zh: 直接保存输入框中的密码。
en: Store the password exactly as entered.

zh: 删除保险库前需要验证密码。
en: Verify the password before deleting the vault.

zh: 密码验证失败，请检查密码、密钥文件或文件完整性。
en: Password verification failed; check the password, key file, or file integrity.

zh: 关闭时保留原密码；开启后输入新密码。仅修改账号信息时不会解密原密码。
en: Leave this off to keep the existing password; turn it on to enter a new password. Editing account details does not decrypt the existing password.

zh: 仅用于本次操作；60 秒后、锁定、后台或离开页面时会清除。
en: Used only for this operation; it is cleared after 60 seconds, lock, backgrounding, or leaving the page.

zh: 仅用于本次同步备用入口；不会写入主保险库会话或持久化文件。
en: Used only to sync the alternate entry this time; it is not stored in the primary vault session or persisted file.

zh: 密码已复制；若剪贴板仍是本次内容，将在 {seconds} 秒后自动清空。
en: Password copied; if the clipboard still matches this value, it will be cleared after {seconds} seconds.

zh: 主密码强度不足：建议使用更长的短语，或混合大小写、数字和符号。
en: The master password is too weak: use a longer passphrase or mix upper/lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.

zh: 连续解锁失败过多，请等待 {seconds} 秒后再试。
en: Too many failed unlock attempts; wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.

zh: 已迁移旧记录元数据并重新保存保险库。
en: Legacy record metadata was migrated and the vault was saved again.

zh: 开启后，移动端在解锁、显示或复制密码等敏感操作前会调用系统指纹或人脸识别；主密码仍然必须输入。
en: When enabled on mobile, the system fingerprint or face check is required before unlocking, showing, or copying passwords. The master password is still required.

zh: 请完成系统生物识别以继续访问密码库。
en: Authenticate with system biometrics to continue accessing the password vault.

zh: 请先完成一次系统生物识别以启用二次确认。
en: Authenticate once with system biometrics to enable second confirmation.

zh: 此设备未提供可用的系统生物识别，或尚未录入指纹/人脸。
en: No usable system biometrics are available on this device, or no fingerprint/face is enrolled.

zh: 生物识别未通过，操作已取消。
en: Biometric authentication failed; the operation was cancelled.

zh: 已启用生物识别二次确认。
密码已临时显示；关闭弹窗后不会保存在页面缓存中。
en: Password was shown once; after closing the dialog it is not kept in the page cache.

zh: 系统剪贴板可能被输入法、历史记录、同步剪贴板、辅助功能或其他应用读取。确认后会复制密码，并在 {seconds} 秒后尽力清空未变化的剪贴板。
en: The system clipboard may be read by keyboards, clipboard history, sync services, accessibility tools, or other apps. If you continue, the password is copied and the unchanged clipboard is cleared after {seconds} seconds when possible.

zh: 重命名“{name}”前，请验证主密码。
en: Verify the primary password before renaming "{name}".

zh: 用于确认你有权修改这个本地保险库；不会写入文件。
en: Used to confirm that you can modify this local vault; it is not written to the file.

zh: 新增账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before adding accounts

zh: 关闭后，当前解锁会话会临时保留主密码以便新增账号，直到锁定或超时。
en: When off, the unlocked session temporarily keeps the master password for adding accounts until lock or timeout.

zh: 修改账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before editing accounts

zh: 关闭后，当前解锁会话会临时保留主密码以便修改账号信息。
en: When off, the unlocked session temporarily keeps the master password for editing account records.

zh: 删除账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before deleting accounts

zh: 关闭后，删除账号仍会弹出删除确认，但不额外要求主密码。
en: When off, deleting accounts still asks for deletion confirmation but skips the extra master password prompt.

zh: 当前{kind}未达到本地强度建议，估算强度约 {bits} bit。较弱密码更容易被离线猜解；继续保存前请确认这是你的明确选择。
en: The current {kind} does not meet the local strength recommendation. Estimated strength is about {bits} bits. Weaker passwords are easier to guess offline; confirm this is your explicit choice before saving.

zh: 在同一面板中选择操作、搜索账号并查看记录。
en: Choose actions, search accounts, and review records in one panel.

zh: 当前保险库、账号搜索和记录操作集中在这里。
en: The active vault, account search, and record actions are grouped here.

zh: 安全设置取值无效，请重新选择清理或锁定时间。
en: The safety setting value is invalid. Choose the cleanup or lock timeout again.

zh: 纯色全屏补光，支持亮度、色温、色板和柔和呼吸模式。
en: Full-screen solid color fill light with brightness, warmth, presets, and a gentle breathing mode.

zh: 用手机屏幕提供可控纯色补光，适合拍照、临时照明和氛围打光。
en: Use the phone screen as a controllable solid fill light for photos, temporary lighting, and soft ambience.

zh: 先调颜色、亮度和色温，再进入沉浸式全屏补光。
en: Tune color, brightness, and warmth before entering immersive full-screen lighting.

zh: 全屏模式会保持屏幕常亮；呼吸模式节奏较慢，避免高频闪烁。
en: Full-screen mode keeps the screen awake; breathing mode is intentionally slow to avoid rapid flashing.

zh: 点击屏幕隐藏或显示控制条。
en: Tap the screen to hide or show controls.

zh: 基于定位流显示实时速度、最高速度、里程和定位精度。
en: Show live speed, max speed, distance, and GPS accuracy from the location stream.

zh: 适合步行、骑行和车内临时测速；精度取决于定位信号。
en: Useful for walking, cycling, and temporary in-vehicle speed checks; accuracy depends on location signal.

zh: 开始后持续读取定位速度，并记录本次里程和最高速度。
en: Start tracking to read location speed continuously and record distance plus max speed.

zh: 定位服务未开启，请先在系统设置中打开定位。
en: Location service is off. Enable location in system settings first.

zh: 定位权限被拒绝，无法读取速度。
en: Location permission was denied, so speed cannot be read.

zh: 定位权限已被永久拒绝，请到系统设置中授权。
en: Location permission is permanently denied. Grant it in system settings.

zh: 定位流不可用，请稍后重试或检查设备定位能力。
en: The location stream is unavailable. Try again later or check device location capability.

zh: 专业科学计算器，支持表达式、数值积分、导数、极限、方程求根、线性代数和概率计算。
en: Professional scientific calculator for expressions, numerical integrals, derivatives, limits, root solving, linear algebra, and probability.

zh: 输入表达式或切换专业面板，完成科学计算、矩阵运算和概率分布估算。
en: Enter expressions or switch professional panels for scientific math, matrix operations, and probability estimates.

zh: 支持隐式乘法、阶乘、pi/tau/phi/e/ans/mem、三角/双曲函数、root/pow/gcd/lcm/nCr/nPr 和 log(base,value)。
en: Supports implicit multiplication, factorial, pi/tau/phi/e/ans/mem, trig/hyperbolic functions, root/pow/gcd/lcm/nCr/nPr, and log(base,value).

zh: MS 保存当前结果，MR 插入记忆值，MC 清空记忆值。
en: MS stores the current result, MR inserts memory, and MC clears memory.

zh: 相机实时放大，支持变焦、补光灯、冻结画面和摄像头切换。
en: Live camera magnifier with zoom, torch, freeze frame, and camera switching.

zh: 用摄像头放大小字、纹理和细节，可冻结画面便于查看。
en: Use the camera to enlarge small text, texture, and details, with freeze frame for inspection.

zh: 滑动调整变焦；需要时打开补光灯或冻结当前画面。
en: Adjust zoom with the slider; turn on torch or freeze the frame when needed.

zh: 相机初始化失败，请检查权限或设备状态。
en: Camera initialization failed. Check permission or device state.

zh: 当前设备不支持此变焦设置。
en: This zoom setting is not supported by the device.

zh: 补光灯不可用或被系统拒绝。
en: Torch is unavailable or rejected by the system.
Failed to freeze the frame. Try again.

zh: 读取环境光传感器，显示 lux、最小/最大值和光照等级。
en: Read the ambient light sensor and show lux, min/max values, and light bands.

zh: 使用设备光线传感器估算环境照度；不支持的设备会显示降级状态。
en: Estimate ambient illuminance from the device light sensor; unsupported devices show a fallback state.

zh: 数据来自系统光线传感器，适合快速判断明暗变化。
en: Data comes from the system light sensor and is best for quick brightness checks.

zh: 当前平台没有可用的环境光传感器接口。
en: This platform has no available ambient light sensor interface.

zh: 查看系统、屏幕、电量、充电状态、内存和热状态快照。
en: View system, screen, battery, charging, memory, and thermal snapshots.

zh: 按周期刷新关键设备状态，便于排查电量、屏幕和系统信息。
en: Refresh key device state periodically to inspect battery, screen, and system information.

zh: 电量、屏幕和内存信息会自动刷新。
en: Battery, screen, and memory information refresh automatically.

zh: 当前平台没有提供设备信息通道。
en: This platform does not provide the device information channel.

zh: 支持 GPS 两点距离和基于倾角的近距离估算。
en: Supports GPS two-point distance and tilt-based close-range estimation.

zh: 用定位标记两点距离，或输入目标高度后通过手机倾角粗估距离。
en: Mark two GPS points, or enter target height and estimate distance from phone tilt.

zh: 适合户外较远距离，结果依赖定位精度。
en: Useful outdoors over longer distances; results depend on GPS accuracy.

zh: 输入手机到目标底部的垂直高度，瞄准目标底部后读取粗略距离。
en: Enter vertical height from phone to target base, aim at the base, then read a rough distance.

zh: 当前平台无法读取倾角传感器。
en: This platform cannot read the tilt sensor.

zh: 当前位置读取失败，请重试。
en: Failed to read the current location. Try again.

zh: 根据起床、入睡和午睡偏好生成昼夜节律时间线。
en: Generate a circadian timeline from wake, bedtime, and nap preferences.

zh: 用本地计算生成光照、专注、咖啡因、午睡和睡前放松窗口。
en: Use local calculations for light, focus, caffeine, nap, and wind-down windows.

zh: 设置常用起床和入睡时间，选择偏早或偏晚的作息类型。
en: Set usual wake and bedtime, then choose an earlier or later chronotype.

zh: 以下时间是参考窗口，可按个人体感微调。
en: These times are reference windows and can be adjusted by personal response.

zh: 起床后尽快接触自然光，帮助稳定当天节律。
en: Get natural light soon after waking to anchor the day.

zh: 适合户外散步或打开明亮环境光。
en: Good for a walk outside or a brighter light environment.

zh: 安排需要清醒度和执行力的任务。
en: Schedule tasks that need alertness and executive focus.

zh: 之后尽量减少咖啡因，避免影响夜间入睡。
en: Reduce caffeine after this point to protect sleep onset.

zh: 短午睡更适合恢复精力，避免拖到傍晚。
en: A short nap can restore energy; avoid pushing it into late evening.

zh: 降低光照和刺激强度，给睡眠留出缓冲。
en: Lower light and stimulation to create a buffer before sleep.

zh: 保持稳定入睡时间更利于节律同步。
en: A stable bedtime helps keep the rhythm aligned.

zh: 拍照或导入图片，添加贴图标签、边框和文字后导出 PNG。
en: Capture or import a photo, add sticker labels, frames, and text, then export PNG.

zh: 本地合成贴图效果，支持样式、颜色、位置和缩放。
en: Compose sticker effects locally with style, color, position, and scale controls.

zh: 预览中调好贴图位置，再拍照或用导入图片导出成品。
en: Adjust sticker position in preview, then capture or export from an imported image.

zh: 相机不可用，可先导入图片制作贴图。
en: Camera is unavailable; import an image to make a sticker photo.

zh: 相机初始化失败，请检查权限或改用导入图片。
en: Camera initialization failed. Check permission or use image import.

zh: 没有可用照片，请先拍照或导入图片。
en: No photo is available. Capture or import an image first.

zh: 导入视频，截取指定片段并压缩导出为 GIF。
en: Import a video, trim a selected range, and export a compressed GIF.

zh: 选择视频后拖动裁剪范围，设置帧率、宽度和质量，再生成 GIF。
en: Pick a video, drag the trim range, set FPS, width, and quality, then create a GIF.

zh: 选择本地视频文件；工具会按系统播放器能力加载预览，不会一次性读取整段视频到内存。
en: Choose a local video file. The tool loads a preview through the system player without reading the whole video into memory.

zh: 导出会按所选范围生成 GIF；片段越长、帧率和宽度越高，文件越大。
en: Export creates a GIF from the selected range. Longer clips, higher FPS, and wider output create larger files.

zh: 至少需要两张可解码图片。
en: At least two decodable images are required.

zh: GIF 生成失败，请缩短范围或降低帧率、宽度、质量后重试。
en: GIF creation failed. Try a shorter range or lower FPS, width, or quality.

zh: 本地创建 ZIP/TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ 归档，并预览或解压常见归档。
en: Create ZIP, TAR, GZip, BZip2, or XZ archives locally, and preview or extract common archives.

zh: 适合移动端临时打包和解压；可创建 ZIP、TAR、tar.gz、tar.bz2、tar.xz、gz、bz2、xz，并识别 RAR/7z 限制。
en: Useful for temporary mobile packing and extraction. Create ZIP, TAR, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, gz, bz2, or xz archives, with clear RAR/7z limitation notices.

zh: 选择多个文件或一个文件夹，设置格式和等级后生成归档；只有 ZIP 可设置压缩算法和密码。
en: Pick multiple files or one folder, then set format and level before creating an archive. Only ZIP supports compression algorithm and password settings.

zh: 可选；留空表示不使用密码。
en: Optional. Leave blank to skip password protection.

zh: 只有 ZIP 归档支持密码保护。
en: Only ZIP archives support password protection.

zh: 只有 ZIP 归档支持密码保护；TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ 会生成无密码归档或压缩流。
en: Only ZIP archives support password protection. TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ create passwordless archives or streams.

zh: 导入 ZIP、TAR、GZip、BZip2 或 XZ 后先预览条目，再解压到应用文档目录；RAR/7z 会显示限制提示。
en: Import ZIP, TAR, GZip, BZip2, or XZ, preview entries, then extract to the app documents directory. RAR/7z show limitation notices.

zh: Web 环境已将解压结果重新打包为 ZIP 下载：{path}
en: Web extraction was repacked as a ZIP download: {path}

zh: 已选择多个文件，当前单文件流格式会自动输出为 {format}。
en: Multiple files are selected, so this single-file stream format will output as {format}.

zh: 大文件可能需要一些时间，请保持页面打开。
en: Large archives can take a while. Keep this page open.

zh: 所选文件无法读取内容，请换用文件提供器中的本地文件。
en: The selected files have no readable bytes. Choose local files from the file provider.

zh: 归档生成失败，请检查文件内容和压缩配置。
en: Archive creation failed. Check the files and archive settings.

zh: 压缩包读取失败，文件可能损坏、加密或格式不受支持。
en: Failed to read the archive. The file may be damaged, encrypted, or unsupported.

zh: 解压失败，请检查文件内容。
en: Extraction failed. Check the archive contents.

zh: 已识别为 7z 文件，但当前内置移动端解压器尚未启用 7z 容器解码；请先转为 ZIP 或 TAR，或后续接入原生 7z 解码器。
en: This is recognized as a 7z file, but the built-in mobile extractor does not enable 7z container decoding yet. Convert it to ZIP or TAR, or add a native 7z decoder later.

zh: 当前 Web 环境不支持解压到本地目录。
en: The current web environment cannot extract to a local directory.

zh: 当前平台不支持直接选择文件夹，请改用多文件选择。
en: This platform cannot pick folders directly. Use multi-file selection instead.

zh: GZip、BZip2 和 XZ 是单文件流格式，请只选择一个文件，或改用 TAR/ZIP。
en: GZip, BZip2, and XZ are single-file stream formats. Select one file only, or use TAR/ZIP.

zh: ZIP 读取失败，请确认解压密码或加密方式是否受支持。
en: ZIP reading failed. Check the extract password or whether this encryption method is supported.

zh: 已识别为 RAR 文件，但当前内置移动端解压器尚未启用 RAR 容器解码；请先转为 ZIP 或 TAR。
en: This is recognized as a RAR file, but the built-in mobile extractor does not enable RAR container decoding yet. Convert it to ZIP or TAR first.

zh: 对函数、矩阵和概率问题使用独立面板，结果按数值方法估算。
en: Use dedicated panels for functions, matrices, and probability. Results are estimated numerically.

zh: 使用 x 作为变量，例如 sin(x)/x、x^2-2。
en: Use x as the variable, for example sin(x)/x or x^2-2.

zh: 函数分析失败，请检查表达式、区间或变量 x。
en: Function analysis failed. Check the expression, range, or variable x.

zh: 行用分号分隔，列用逗号或空格分隔，例如 1,2;3,4。
en: Separate rows with semicolons and columns with commas or spaces, for example 1,2;3,4.
Used for solving Ax=b, for example 5,6.

zh: 矩阵计算失败，请检查维度、数值和是否可逆。
en: Matrix calculation failed. Check dimensions, values, and invertibility.

zh: 概率计算失败，请检查 n、k、p、均值和标准差。
en: Probability calculation failed. Check n, k, p, mean, and standard deviation.

zh: 选择一个专业计算动作后显示结果。
en: Run a professional calculation to show a result.

zh: 拖动范围滑块选择要转换的片段，可用预览按钮检查播放范围。
en: Drag the range slider to choose the segment to convert. Use preview to check the playback range.

zh: 先导入视频，然后选择要转换成 GIF 的范围。
en: Import a video first, then choose the range to convert to GIF.

zh: 无法读取该视频路径，请换一个本地视频文件。
en: Cannot read this video path. Try another local video file.

zh: 视频加载失败，请确认该平台播放器可解码此文件，或换用常见 MP4/H.264、MOV、M4V、WebM 文件。
en: Video loading failed. Make sure this platform can decode the file, or try a common MP4/H.264, MOV, M4V, or WebM file.

zh: 当前平台暂不支持本地视频转 GIF，请在 Android 或 iOS 设备上使用。
en: This platform does not support local video to GIF yet. Use an Android or iOS device.

zh: 视频文件存在，但系统播放器无法解码。请换用 MP4/H.264、MOV、M4V、3GP 或平台支持的视频。
en: The video file exists, but the system player could not decode it. Try MP4/H.264, MOV, M4V, 3GP, or another platform-supported video.

zh: 无法读取视频时长，请换用可正常播放的视频文件。
en: Could not read the video duration. Try a video file that plays normally.

zh: 视频可加载，但 GIF 抽帧失败。请缩短范围，或降低帧率、宽度和质量后重试。
en: The video loaded, but GIF frame extraction failed. Try a shorter range or lower FPS, width, and quality.

zh: 导出的 GIF 文件不存在，请重新生成后再保存。
en: The exported GIF file no longer exists. Create it again before saving.

zh: 女性生理周期辅助工具，估算经期、排卵日、易孕窗口和下次经期。
en: Menstrual cycle assistant for estimating period dates, ovulation, fertile window, and next period.

zh: 基于最近一次经期和周期长度进行本地估算，适合作为生活辅助记录。
en: Estimate locally from the last period date and cycle length as a lifestyle aid.

zh: 输入最近一次经期开始日，并根据自身情况调整周期、经期和黄体期长度。
en: Enter the last period start date and adjust cycle, period, and luteal length to your situation.

zh: 按月份标记经期、卵泡期、易孕窗口、排卵日和黄体期，点击日期查看详情。
en: Marks period, follicular phase, fertile window, ovulation, and luteal phase by month. Tap a day for details.

zh: 记录出血和身体感受，必要时降低运动强度并注意休息。
en: Track bleeding and symptoms, reduce exercise intensity if needed, and prioritize rest.

zh: 这是基于排卵日前后估算的高受孕概率窗口，仅作生活辅助。
en: This higher-conception window is estimated around ovulation and is for lifestyle reference only.

zh: 排卵日会受压力、睡眠、疾病和周期波动影响，实际时间可能变化。
en: Ovulation can shift with stress, sleep, illness, and cycle variation. Actual timing may differ.

zh: 如果经期长期不规律、异常疼痛或出血异常，请咨询专业医生。
en: If periods are long-term irregular, unusually painful, or bleeding is abnormal, consult a clinician.

zh: 本工具只提供周期估算和生活记录辅助，不用于避孕、诊断或治疗。
en: This tool provides cycle estimates and lifestyle tracking only. It is not for contraception, diagnosis, or treatment.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，处于经期估算范围。关注疼痛、出血量和疲劳变化。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length} of the cycle and falls in the estimated period range. Track pain, flow, and fatigue.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，通常处于经期后到易孕窗口前的恢复与能量回升阶段。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, usually the recovery and rising-energy phase after the period and before the fertile window.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，接近估算排卵窗口，实际时间可能随身体状态波动。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, close to the estimated ovulation window. Actual timing may shift with body conditions.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，接近估算排卵日。若用于备孕或避孕，请结合专业建议。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, close to the estimated ovulation day. For conception or contraception, use professional guidance.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，通常处于排卵后的黄体期，可关注睡眠、情绪和经前不适。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, usually the luteal phase after ovulation. Track sleep, mood, and premenstrual symptoms.

zh: 历史年表、元素周期表和知识辅助工具。
en: Timeline, periodic table, and knowledge helpers.

zh: 当前本地转 GIF 后端支持 Android/iOS，文件选择覆盖 MP4、MOV、M4V、WebM、3GP、AVI、MKV、WMV、MPEG 等；实际加载取决于系统播放器和抽帧能力。
en: The current local GIF backend supports Android/iOS. The picker covers MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM, 3GP, AVI, MKV, WMV, MPEG, and similar files; actual loading depends on the system player and frame extraction support.

zh: 可把高强度训练改为散步、拉伸或轻量活动，优先补水和休息。
en: Consider swapping high-intensity training for walking, stretching, or light movement, and prioritize hydration and rest.

zh: 若疼痛明显加重、出血量异常或伴随发热眩晕，请及时寻求专业医疗建议。
en: Seek professional medical advice if pain becomes much worse, bleeding is unusual, or fever/dizziness appears.

zh: 能量回升时适合安排学习、训练或复杂任务，但仍以真实疲劳感为准。
en: As energy rises, it can be a good time for learning, training, or complex tasks, while still following actual fatigue cues.

zh: 记录睡眠、皮肤、食欲和情绪变化，有助于判断自己的周期节律。
en: Track sleep, skin, appetite, and mood changes to learn your own cycle rhythm.

zh: 可观察宫颈黏液、基础体温或排卵试纸等身体信号，估算结果不能单独作为依据。
en: Observe body signs such as cervical mucus, basal temperature, or ovulation tests; estimates alone should not be the only basis.

zh: 若用于备孕、避孕或用药安排，请结合医生建议和更可靠的检测方式。
en: For conception, contraception, or medication planning, combine this with clinician guidance and more reliable checks.

zh: 排卵日可能因压力、睡眠、疾病、旅行或周期不规律而前后移动。
en: Ovulation may shift with stress, sleep, illness, travel, or irregular cycles.

zh: 若出现单侧轻微不适可先记录；剧烈疼痛或异常出血不应只按周期解释。
en: Record mild one-sided discomfort if it appears; severe pain or unusual bleeding should not be explained only by the cycle.

zh: 黄体期可更关注睡眠、盐分摄入、咖啡因和情绪压力，减少经前不适触发因素。
en: In the luteal phase, pay closer attention to sleep, salt intake, caffeine, and stress to reduce premenstrual triggers.

zh: 若经前情绪、疼痛或水肿持续影响生活，建议记录连续几个周期并咨询专业人士。
en: If premenstrual mood, pain, or bloating keeps affecting life, track several cycles and consult a professional.

zh: 已识别该视频文件，但当前平台未接入视频预览和 GIF 导出后端。请在 Android 或 iOS 设备上转换。
en: The video file was recognized, but this platform does not have the video preview or GIF export backend wired. Convert it on Android or iOS.

zh: 无法读取视频容器信息，请确认文件可访问且不是损坏的视频。
en: Could not read the video container information. Make sure the file is accessible and not damaged.

zh: {length} 个实用工具，按 {categories} 个精准分类整理，支持搜索、快捷入口和统一来源页。
en: {length} handy tools organized into {categories} focused categories with search, quick access, and a unified source page.

zh: 时钟、弹幕、补光和计分等直接面向屏幕展示的工具。
en: Clock, barrage, fill light, and scoreboard tools for direct screen display.

zh: 手机状态、震动、压缩归档、提醒和模拟来电等系统辅助工具。
en: System helpers for phone status, vibration, archives, reminders, and fake calls.

zh: 尺子、指南针、水平仪、测速、放大镜、照度和测距等传感器工具。
en: Sensor tools for ruler, compass, level, speed, magnifier, light, and distance measurement.

zh: 取色、图片处理、表情包、设备外框、视频转 GIF、证件照和网页图片导出。
en: Color picking, image processing, memes, device frames, video to GIF, ID photos, and image-to-web export.

zh: 壁纸、邮编、以图搜图、垃圾分类、短链和二维码等联网或跳转工具。
en: Wallpaper, postal codes, reverse image search, recycling lookup, short links, and QR tools.

zh: 字数统计、文本转换、上下标和简易脑图等文本编辑辅助。
en: Text helpers for counting, transforms, superscript/subscript, and simple mind maps.

zh: 单位、科学计算、周期、工作性价比、城市薪资、房贷、日期、世界时钟、BMI、亲属称谓和 Offer 决策。
en: Unit, scientific, cycle, work-worth, city salary, mortgage, date, world clock, BMI, kinship, and offer calculators.

zh: 统一查看生活工具使用的第三方页面、公开数据与实现参考。
en: Unified list of third-party pages, public data, and implementation references used by life tools.

zh: 按工具集中查看外部链接；实际版权、可用性和服务条款以原站为准。
en: Review external links by tool; copyright, availability, and terms follow the original sites.

zh: 这里集中展示生活工具模块中声明过的外部来源，避免在各工具页分散展示。
en: This page gathers external sources declared by life tools so they are not scattered across tool pages.

zh: 来源链接用于资料核对、能力边界说明或实现形态参考；生活工具内的本地功能不默认代表原站完整能力。
en: Source links are for verification, capability boundaries, or implementation reference; local life-tool features do not imply full parity with the original sites.
